research_alignment: NER span benchmarks usually score exact span and label matches.
Relation extraction benchmarks score typed source-relation-target predictions.
Triple benchmarks score subject-predicate-object exact matches.
Entity resolution benchmarks commonly use pairwise precision, recall, and F1.
GraphRAG retrieval checks combine context recall, path usefulness, citations, and faithfulness.
details.scope: tiny human-reviewed fixtures for public correctness checks

rows.details: Scores exact text, label, start, and end offsets. TP=3, FP=0, FN=0.
rows.gold_unit: exact entity spans with label, start, and end
rows.predicted_unit: regex Incident/Date spans plus gazetteer System spans

rows.details: Scores typed relation mentions by source name, relation type, and target name. TP=2, FP=0, FN=0.
rows.gold_unit: human-reviewed source, relation type, and target mentions
rows.predicted_unit: dependency-style relation pattern candidates with evidence

rows.details: Scores RDF-style triples by exact subject, predicate, and object. TP=2, FP=0, FN=0.
Scores pairwise ER precision/recall/F1. Merge audit rows: 3.
rows.gold_unit: human-reviewed duplicate clusters converted to gold merge pairs
rows.predicted_unit: canonical clusters with merge audit metadata

rows.gold_unit: queries with relevant contexts, paths, citations, and answer hints
rows.predicted_unit: top-k graph contexts ranked by lexical query/context overlap
